title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1971-02-19
lineage: AUD > 1st gen reel > Teac A-2300SX > RCA out > Audiophile 2496 > Wavelab 4.0 > CD Wave> mkwACT > WAV > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Above‑average audience tape captures Good Lovin' and the debut of Bird Song/Deal, though the tape‑flip between The Other One and Wharf Rat is a noticeable hiccup.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source that benefits from modern taper assistance, delivering a clear enough picture of the 1971 show with decent ambience. Musically the concert offers rare first‑time performances of Bird Song and Deal and a solid rendition of Good Lovin', but the abrupt tape flip between The Other One and Wharf Rat breaks the flow, leaving the overall experience mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the set 3‑5 stars, praising the rarity of certain songs and a generally good audience recording, while noting tape‑flip issues and uneven sound quality that keep it from higher marks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Above‑average AUD capture with clear crowd ambience; some reviewers note minor muffling and a tape‑flip glitch between The Other One and Wharf Rat, but overall the tape is listenable.

poor_songs: The Other One / Wharf Rat transition (tape flip issue)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Features first‑time debuts of Bird Song and Deal, but the abrupt tape flip in the middle of the second set disrupts continuity.
